lead_fa: Outlaw یک اسپک تند و پرکست (builder/spender) است: با انرژی جنراتور می‌زنی و کانبو پوینت‌ها را با فینیشرها خرج می‌کنی؛ همه‌چیز با CDR دائمی [[Restless Blades]] می‌چرخد. AoEات از [[Blade Flurry]] می‌آید که با همین روتیشن تک‌هدف کِلیو می‌زند و [[Roll the Bones]] ریسک و شانس به بازی‌ات اضافه می‌کند. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Trickster]] با [[Unseen Blade]] و [[Killing Spree]] که با تنظیم فعلی حدود 7% قوی‌تر است، و [[Fatebound]] با [[Hand of Fate]] و شیر یا خط‌هایش.

strengths: Strong AoE damage against up to 5 targets while carrying out the regular single-target rotation, thanks to Blade Flurry
Fun and fast-paced spec with a lot of abilities to press, built around continuous cooldown reduction via Restless Blades
Good kits for both mobility and utility
weaknesses: The reliance on cooldown reduction means Outlaw suffers the most from downtime and being unable to hit enemies with abilities
Always in steep competition with other, more reliable Rogue specs
Blade Flurry is target capped to 5 targets (up to 8 with talents)
Not everyone likes the randomness of Roll the Bones

buffs: New abilities in Midnight: Deadly Pursuit, Fast Action and Preparation
Blade Flurry's target cap can be increased to 8 with talents
nerfs: Removed abilities in Midnight: Crackshot and Underhanded Upper Hand
changes_12_1.note: Wowhead lists these as Midnight-wide changes; per the talent page, with current tuning Trickster is tuned about 7% better than Fatebound while also having access to better QoL talents (stated for patch 12.0.5).

hero.recommendation: Trickster firmly beats out Fatebound in all situations with current tuning (about 7% better) while also having access to better QoL talents; the talent page carries the Best tags for Raid, Mythic+ and Delves on Trickster. Neither hero alters the rotation in a massive way.
hero.trickster: Focuses on the Unseen Blade passive: after proccing 4 times it upgrades Dispatch into Coup de Grace which deals increased damage. The other focus is Killing Spree, with Disorienting Strikes giving it a lower cooldown and Flawless Form giving a stacking damage buff.
hero.fatebound: Focused on the Hand of Fate proc: every finisher flips a coin; heads buffs your damage while tails deals damage. After 7 coins the Lucky Coin capstone grants a damage buff while increasing the bonuses each face provides.
hero.comparison_source_note: Wowhead overview and talent page (JustGuy, updated 2026-10-13): Trickster firmly beats Fatebound in all situations, about 7% tuned better, with Best tags on all three modes.

builds.notes: Outlaw's single target and AoE setups look very similar: with all AoE damage coming from Blade Flurry, the AoE build drops low-impact single target talents for the talents that buff Blade Flurry further.

concepts: Cooldowns on cooldown: Blade Rush, Adrenaline Rush and Between the Eyes are the primary cooldowns to press
React to procs while keeping pace: Opportunity (enhanced generator) and Ace Up Your Sleeve (combo points after Between the Eyes) at a high actions-per-minute rate
Manage resources: avoid overcapping Combo Points as much as possible
A fairly simple spec past the high APM requirements: press cooldowns on cooldown, spend combo points efficiently and never miss a global
Positioning is key: uptime feeds Restless Blades cooldown reduction, and Blade Flurry is centered on the player so you must hit the maximum number of targets
Use cooldowns ASAP to start cycling their CDR via Restless Blades
st_priority: Cast Roll the Bones on cooldown if at stage 1 or less; while Loaded Dice is active, recast at stage 2 or less
Cast Keep It Rolling if you have a stage 3 or higher Roll the Bones active
Cast Preparation whenever Between the Eyes, Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree are on cooldown
Cast Adrenaline Rush on cooldown at 2 or fewer combo points, followed by Killing Spree
Cast Between the Eyes at 6 or more combo points
Cast Dispatch with the 4-set bonus active
Cast Dispatch at 6 or more combo points
Cast Pistol Shot if Opportunity has 6 stacks, or 3 stacks and you are at 1-3 combo points
Cast Sinister Strike at 5 or fewer combo points
aoe_priority: Cast Blade Flurry if there are 2 or more targets in range; with exactly 2 targets, use it as a high-priority combo point builder at 5 or fewer combo points
Cast Roll the Bones on cooldown if at stage 1 or less; while Loaded Dice is active, recast at stage 2 or less
Cast Keep It Rolling if you have a stage 3 or higher Roll the Bones active
Cast Preparation whenever Between the Eyes, Adrenaline Rush, Killing Spree and Blade Rush are on cooldown
Cast Adrenaline Rush on cooldown at 2 or fewer combo points, followed by Killing Spree
Cast Between the Eyes at 6 or more combo points
Cast Dispatch with the 4-set bonus active
Cast Dispatch at 6 or more combo points
Cast Pistol Shot if Opportunity has 6 stacks, or 3 stacks and you are at 1-3 combo points
Cast Sinister Strike at 5 or fewer combo points
rotation.aoe_note: In AoE the only adjustment Outlaw has to make is adding Blade Flurry to its spells that need to be cast on cooldown; the rest of the priority stays the same.

cooldowns.Adrenaline Rush: Dramatic energy regen increase and a lowered GCD that scales with Haste (0.8 seconds at 25% Haste; only 22% raw needed due to Alacrity); good play directly links to more uptime through Restless Blades
cooldowns.Roll the Bones: A random stage of 4 possible outcomes, each stage granting its bonus alongside all previous ones: Stage 1 increased Opportunity chance, Stage 2 Sinister Strike generates an additional combo point, Stage 3 increased Restless Blades effectiveness, Stage 4 increased Critical Strike chance
cooldowns.Keep It Rolling: Despite the massive 6-minute cooldown its effective in-combat cooldown is only around 1:15 thanks to Restless Blades; use it any time Roll the Bones is at stage 3 or higher to avoid wasting it
cooldowns.Preparation: Mostly autopilot when the conditions are met; it does not interact with Restless Blades, so on short encounters (around 3 minutes) you always get 1 cast and can save it for the best burn phase

rotation.hero_notes: With the Fatebound hero selected the page renders two threshold differences in single target: Keep It Rolling at stage 2 or higher and Dispatch at 5 or more combo points. Neither hero alters the rotation in a massive way per the overview.
opener: Cast Keep It Rolling if at stage 3 or higher
Build with Sinister Strike and Pistol Shot until 6 or more combo points

gear.gearing_rules: Agility first (item level is almost king); get Haste-heavy pieces until 23% Haste for both Trickster and Fatebound. Critical Strike and Versatility are nearly even for most players with Critical Strike slightly ahead; consider external or temporary stat sources (weapon enchants, trinket procs) when judging a piece. With the larger Season 2 stat pools you cap out on both Crit and Haste, which pushes towards stacking Versatility.

tier_set.name: Chosen Bloodslayer's Hexweave
tier_set.note: 2pc: Dispatch damage increased by 15%. 4pc: Sinister Strike and Ambush have a 20% chance to cause your next Dispatch to be free and deal damage as if you spent the maximum combo points; the 4-set provides a lot of bonus energy and an additional proc to track during the rotation.

stats.cheatsheet: Agility > Haste (until 23%) > Critical Strike > Versatility > Mastery for both Trickster and Fatebound; item level is almost king.
notes: Critical Strike gives a chance for extra effectiveness on attacks and heals (double damage or healing).
Haste increases attack speed, energy regen and the GCD reduction effect of Adrenaline Rush.
Mastery increases the damage of Mastery: Main Gauche.
External stat sources like weapon enchants and trinket procs shift the value of a stat for your character.

mplus.hero_note: Trickster is the Best-tagged hero for Mythic+ this season, about 7% tuned better than Fatebound with better QoL talents. AoE comes entirely from Blade Flurry, which is centered on the player.
tips: Cast Blade Flurry with 2 or more targets in range; with exactly 2 targets use it as a high-priority builder at 5 or fewer combo points
Position so Blade Flurry hits the maximum number of targets: its radius is centered on you
Avoid downtime above all: every second off target snowballs into lost Restless Blades cooldown reduction
Use cooldowns as soon as possible so Restless Blades starts cycling their cooldown reduction
React to Opportunity procs and Ace Up Your Sleeve combo points between casts
